tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in the user's Linear workspace, including active Triage Intelligence suggestions for issues in triage. For issues assigned to me, use "me" as the assignee. For issues created by me, use "me" as the creator. Use "null" for no assignee.

customView.description: Saved view ID, URL, slug, or exact name. Use list_custom_views to discover views. Applies saved filters and scope; other filters narrow the results. Uses list ordering, not saved display settings

delegate.description: Agent name or ID. When the user asks to delegate to "Linear" or "the Linear agent", this refers to the "Linear" app user specifically

fields.description: Fields to include in each result. Explicitly requested fields with no value return null. `id` is always included. Omit or pass an empty array for the default response.

includeSubTeams.description: Include results from the selected team and all descendants when team is set. Team ID filters already include descendants; this also expands name and key filters

parentId.description: Parent issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123)

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

query.description: Search issue title or description. Cannot be combined with customView

triagedAt.description: Left triage after: ISO-8601 date/duration (e.g., -P1D). Issues still in triage have no triagedAt; list them with state "triage"

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about an issue by ID, including attachments, git branch name, and active Triage Intelligence suggestions when the issue is in triage. A nonempty fields selection overrides the include options; request optional fields directly in fields.

fields.description: Fields to include in each result. Explicitly requested fields with no value return null. `id` is always included. Omit or pass an empty array for the default response.

id.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Linear issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. Provide exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId`. For issues, projects, and initiatives this returns both top-level discussion threads and inline description comments. Inline (anchored) comments carry a non-null `quotedText` set to the snippet of description text they reference. Returned comments include `author` and nullable `onBehalfOf`; when set, `onBehalfOf` identifies the user the agent author acted for. Files uploaded in comment bodies are returned in `attachments` with titles and download URLs, not issue attachment IDs. Signed upload URLs expire after five minutes; call list_comments again to refresh them. Download documents using these URLs and process them with your own file tools.

documentId.description: Document ID or slug (provide exactly one parent)

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the user's Linear workspace

customView.description: Saved view ID, URL, slug, or exact name. Use list_custom_views to discover views. Applies saved filters and scope; other filters narrow the results. Uses list ordering, not saved display settings

fields.description: Fields to include in each result. Explicitly requested fields with no value return null. `id` is always included. Omit or pass an empty array for the default response.

includeSubTeams.description: Include results from the selected team and all descendants when team is set. Team ID filters already include descendants; this also expands name and key filters

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific project in Linear

customerNeedsCursor.description: Next customer-needs page: pass customerNeedsPageInfo.endCursor with includeCustomerNeeds true

customerNeedsLimit.description: Customer needs per page when includeCustomerNeeds is true (default 10, max 50)

includeCustomerNeeds.description: Include one page of customer needs attached directly to the project

query.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams in the user's Linear workspace, including their parent IDs and hierarchy names

ancestorTeam.description: All descendant teams of this team, at any depth, excluding itself (name, key, or ID)

parentTeam.description: Only direct sub-teams of this team (name, key, or ID)

tools.name: list_issue_labels
tools.description: List available issue labels in a Linear workspace or team. A retired label carries `retiredAt` and cannot be applied to new issues.

includeGroups.description: Include label groups in the results, marked with `isGroup`. A group cannot be applied directly; retiring or restoring one cascades to its child labels

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific Linear user

tools.name: get_status_updates
tools.description: List or get project/initiative status updates. Pass `id` to get a specific update, or filter to list.

id.description: Status update ID - if provided, returns this specific update

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

tools.name: list_customer_needs
tools.description: List customer needs (customer requests) for an issue, project, or initiative. Provide exactly one of `issue`, `project`, or `initiative`. Project results include requests linked to the project's issues; initiative results include requests on projects in the initiative or any of its sub-initiatives, and on their issues. Returns requests on closed work too; each need includes its issue's workflow state and its project's status so callers can filter. Paginated; pass `cursor` from the previous page to fetch the next.

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug to list needs for

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues to list needs for

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug to list needs for

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the user's Linear workspace

domain.description: Exact customer domain (case-insensitive); combined with other filters

externalIds.description: Match any stored external ID exactly (case-sensitive); combined with other filters
